title: Native transactional chat data schema v2
summary: Add normalized native chat data, verified pre-migration online backup, atomic journal and typed postcommit acknowledgements, scoped history and staged restore. Exact-source native CI and original proof verified; no UI exposure.
migration_notes: Additive v1 to v2. Verify a new local online snapshot before atomic DDL; retain legacy records and backup. Older binaries reject v2; rollback via separate verified v1 staged profile, never overwrite active vault.
